Nexus Mods 页面文案（BBCode）
=====================================
游戏页面：https://www.nexusmods.com/silverpines
上传入口：游戏页 → UPLOAD A MOD（需登录）

【分类怎么选】（2026-10-23 实测该站分类树）
- Category：只有 [b]Miscellaneous[/b] 一个可选（Silver Pines 分类树下就这一项，24 个 mod 全在里面）。别纠结，选它。
- Tags 才是真正描述内容的，建议：[b]Gameplay[/b] + [b]Utilities for Players[/b]。
  别选 Cheats / Trainers —— 主体是手感改造，作弊只是附带的调试开关，挂 Cheats 会被归到修改器那一类。

【Media 这一栏填什么】（上传页 Section 2: Media，三部分）
1) [b]Header Image[/b] —— 页面顶部横幅。官方建议 [b]1400x400[/b]。没有就留空，不影响发布。
2) [b]Mod Images[/b] —— 游戏截图，[b]16:9 / 1920x1080[/b] 最合适，官方建议至少 5 张。
   [u]第一张会成为列表页缩略图[/u]，所以把最能说明问题的那张放第一（建议用枪口瞄准线那张，一眼能看出改了什么）。
   禁止放占位图 / 与 mod 无关的图。
3) [b]Videos[/b] —— [b]只收 YouTube 链接[/b]（Title + URL + 一句说明）。B站链接填这里不认。
   没有 YouTube 就整栏留空，之后能编辑补上。

要传哪些图（对应「发布素材清单.md」第二部分）：
  01-panel-combat.png   面板战斗页        —— 放最后，用来说明可调参数
  03-aimline.png        枪口线特写        —— 放第一张，当缩略图
  04/05-stomp-*.png     踩踏命中 vs 踩空  —— 建议拼成一张左右对比图，算 1 张
  06-dodge-cancel.png   攻击被闪避打断
  再加一张英文面板截图（点 EN 之后），凑满 5 张。

下面三段分别对应 Nexus 上传页的三个字段，直接复制粘贴。


-----------------------------------------------------------------
【1】NAME（页面标题）
-----------------------------------------------------------------
Silver Pines Combat


-----------------------------------------------------------------
【2】SHORT DESCRIPTION（列表页显示的一行，限 ~200 字符）
-----------------------------------------------------------------
Combat feel overhaul for Silver Pines: dodge cancels any attack, stomp closes the gap instead of whiffing, and a thin aim line from the muzzle. Runtime patch - no game file modified.


备选（同一字段，看哪个顺眼用哪个）：
- Tightens Silver Pines combat: dodge-cancel any attack, stomp no longer whiffs in place, and a thin muzzle line shows where you're aiming. IL2CPP runtime patch, nothing on disk touched.
- Three combat fixes for Silver Pines: attacks are dodge-cancellable at any point, stomp snaps forward into range, and aiming draws a thin line from the muzzle. No game files modified.


-----------------------------------------------------------------
【3】DESCRIPTION（正文，BBCode）
-----------------------------------------------------------------

[size=5][b]Silver Pines Combat[/b][/size]
Combat feel overhaul for Silver Pines. Everything is patched in memory at runtime — no game file is ever modified or replaced.

[size=4][b]What it does[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Dodge cancels attacks[/b] — in vanilla you can only cancel during the startup frames and after the hitbox closes. With this patch the whole attack animation is cancellable.
[*][b]Stomp snaps to the enemy[/b] — pressing stomp steps you forward first, closing to exactly stomping range (auto-fitted to the enemy's collider width), so you stop whiffing in place.
[*][b]Aim line[/b] — a thin grey line drawn from the muzzle ([i]ProjectileWeapon.m_muzzle[/i]), fixed length, visible only while actually aiming.
[/list]

Also included: F1–F5 cheat toggles, F6 slow motion, hitbox drawing (off by default). The in-game panel supports English and Chinese.

[size=4][b]Install[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install a BepInEx 6 IL2CPP pack first. There is already one on this site — [b]Silver Pines BepInEx 6 IL2CPP Pack[/b] (be.790). Mods that ship their own BepInEx work too.
[*]Grab [b]SilverPinesCombat-1.0.0.zip[/b] and merge its [i]BepInEx[/i] folder into the game root (Steam → Library → right-click Silver Pines → Manage → Browse local files). Result: [i]BepInEx\plugins\SilverPinesCombat\SilverPinesCombat.dll[/i].
[*]Launch the game. The [b]first launch hangs for 1–3 minutes[/b] — BepInEx is generating ~180 proxy DLLs under [i]BepInEx\interop\[/i]. It looks frozen but isn't; don't kill it. Later launches are instant.
[*]Press F7 in game to show/hide the panel.
[/list]
[b]SilverPinesCombat-1.0.0-full.zip[/b] is the same plugin with BepInEx be.789 bundled, for people starting from nothing. If you already installed be.790 from the pack above, use the small zip — don't mix the two.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
BepInEx 6.0.0-bleeding-edge ([b]be.789 or newer[/b]), IL2CPP, win-x64. The game uses metadata version 39 — older BepInEx builds fail with [i]Unsupported metadata version found! We support 23-29, got 39[/i].


[size=4][b]Hotkeys[/b][/size]
[table]
[tr][th]Key[/th][th]Function[/th][/tr]
[tr][td]F7[/td][td]Show / hide panel[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]F1–F5[/td][td]Invincible / infinite ammo / always weakpoint / infinite stamina / AI oblivious[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]F6[/td][td]Slow motion[/td][/tr]
[/table]
Every toggle and slider is also in the panel. Config file: [i]BepInEx\config\silverpines.combat.cfg[/i]

[size=4][b]What's next[/b][/size]
None of these is in v1.0.0 — this is the direction, not a promise:
[list]
[*][b]Aim assist (soft lock)[/b] — the current line is only an indicator. Next step is bending the shot toward the nearest target within an angle threshold, with a strength slider.
[*][b]Auto pump-action for the shotgun[/b] — the pump parameter lives in a ScriptableObject and can't be changed at runtime, so it needs a different route through the animation state machine.
[*][b]Reload without aiming first[/b] — calling [i]StartReload[/i] directly deadlocks the main thread; the game's own input gate has to be found first.
[*][b]Stomp while moving[/b] — the restriction sits in the attack state machine, not the input layer.
[/list]

[size=4][b]Uninstall[/b][/size]
Delete [i]BepInEx\plugins\SilverPinesCombat\[/i]. Nothing else was touched.

[size=4][b]Source & license[/b][/size]
Source: https://github.com/15172396214/SilverPinesCombat
Mod code: MIT. The bundled BepInEx (in the -full archive) is LGPL-2.1.

Built with BepInEx 6 + Harmony against IL2CPP metadata v39. Type information came from compiling an upstream Il2CppDumper PR branch by hand — the official release doesn't support v39 yet.
